user.title: Set up QuizRooms
user.description: QuizRooms hosts local-first, multi-room confidence-wagering trivia on your Home Assistant instance. By default, guest play and TV dashboards are restricted to your local network only.

data.custom_lan_base_url: Custom LAN Base URL for QR codes (optional)

data_description.allowed_subnets: Type one CIDR subnet at a time (e.g., 100.64.0.0/10) and press Enter to add it. Click × on any chip to remove it.

error.invalid_subnet: One or more CIDR subnets are invalid (example: 192.168.1.0/24 or 100.64.0.0/10). Remove the invalid chip with × and try again.
error.invalid_url: Custom LAN Base URL must start with http:// or https://.
